edid_file.description: Path to the input EDID file to be edited. Can be a binary EDID blob or a DTD text file.

text_mode.description: If true, assumes the edid_file is a DTD text file. If false, assumes it is binary EDID data. Corresponds to the -t/--text flag.

output_dir.description: Directory where the edited/exported EDID data will be written.
